measures.name: Energy MWh
measures.description: Energy delivered by the turbines.

measures.name: Possible Energy MWh
measures.description: What the turbines would have delivered in the wind they had, by the power curve at the air density of the moment.

measures.name: Lost Energy MWh
measures.description: Possible minus delivered energy in periods when a turbine was stopped or limited. Split it by Scada[LossCause].

measures.name: Turbine Hours
measures.description: Hours covered by the data, summed over the turbines.

measures.name: Capacity Factor
measures.description: Energy as a share of what the turbines would deliver at rated power all the time.

measures.name: Average Wind Speed
measures.description: Mean wind speed at the nacelles, m/s.

measures.name: CO2 Avoided t
measures.description: Energy times the average emission intensity of the grid, in tonnes.

measures.name: Time Availability
measures.expression: VAR known = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Scada'), KEEPFILTERS('Scada'[AvailabilityCategory] <> "Information unavailable")) VAR down = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Scada'), KEEPFILTERS('Scada'[AvailabilityCategory] IN {"Forced outage", "Scheduled maintenance", "Planned corrective action"})) RETURN DIVIDE(known - down, known)
measures.description: Share of the time in which a turbine was not down for a fault or for maintenance.

measures.name: Energy Availability
measures.expression: VAR energy = CALCULATE(SUM('Scada'[EnergyKwh]), KEEPFILTERS('Scada'[AvailabilityCategory] <> "Information unavailable")) VAR lost = CALCULATE(SUM('Scada'[LostEnergyKwh]), KEEPFILTERS('Scada'[AvailabilityCategory] <> "Information unavailable"), KEEPFILTERS('Scada'[LossCause] IN {"Component fault", "Scheduled maintenance", "Corrective maintenance", "Technical derate"})) RETURN DIVIDE(energy, energy + lost)
measures.description: Share of the energy that was not lost to the turbine itself.

measures.name: Forced Outage Hours
measures.description: Hours stopped by a fault.

measures.name: Performance Index
measures.description: Energy as a share of possible energy while the turbine ran without any limit. Below 1: worse than the power curve.

measures.name: Average Gearbox Bearing Temp
measures.description: degC.

measures.name: Average Gearbox Vibration
measures.description: mm/s RMS.

measures.name: Curtailed Energy MWh
measures.description: Energy not produced because the grid operator or the buyer limited the site.

measures.name: Curtailment Share
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Curtailed Energy MWh], [Energy MWh] + [Lost Energy MWh])
measures.description: Curtailed energy as a share of energy plus all lost energy.

measures.name: Deemed Generation MWh
measures.description: Curtailed energy that the buyer pays for. A site figure: it does not split by turbine.

measures.name: Unpaid Curtailment MWh
measures.description: Curtailed energy that nobody pays for. A site figure.

measures.name: Failures
measures.description: Faults that needed a technician.

measures.name: Failure Downtime Hours
measures.description: Hours from each fault to the return to service.

measures.name: MTTR Hours
measures.description: Mean time to repair, including waiting for access, parts and people.

measures.name: MTBF Hours
measures.description: Mean time between failures: running hours per failure.

measures.name: Downtime Events
measures.description: Stops and outages of every kind.

measures.name: Open Work Orders
measures.description: Jobs that are not closed: open, in progress or planned.

measures.name: Repair Cost Paid by Owner USD
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM('Work Orders'[TotalCostUsd]), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[WorkType] = "Corrective"), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[Status] = "Closed"), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[CostBorneBy] = "Owner"))
measures.description: Closed corrective work invoiced to the owner, by the day the job was opened.

measures.name: Repair Cost Covered by Warranty USD
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM('Work Orders'[TotalCostUsd]), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[WorkType] = "Corrective"), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[Status] = "Closed"), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[CostBorneBy] = "Warranty"))
measures.description: Closed corrective work that a warranty paid.

measures.name: Repair Cost USD per MWh
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Repair Cost Paid by Owner USD], [Energy MWh])
measures.description: Owner-paid repairs per MWh produced.

measures.name: PM Compliance
measures.expression: VAR due = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Work Orders'), KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK('Work Orders'[PmResult])), USERELATIONSHIP('Work Orders'[ScheduledDate], 'Date'[Date])) VAR in_time = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Work Orders'), KEEPFILTERS('Work Orders'[PmResult] = "Done within a week of the plan"), USERELATIONSHIP('Work Orders'[ScheduledDate], 'Date'[Date])) RETURN DIVIDE(in_time, due)
measures.description: Share of the preventive work due in the period that was done within a week of its planned date.

measures.name: Contract Price USD per MWh
measures.description: Price of the power purchase agreement.

measures.name: Revenue USD
measures.expression: ([Energy MWh] + [Deemed Generation MWh]) * [Contract Price USD per MWh]
measures.description: Energy at the contract price, plus curtailed energy that the buyer pays for. A site figure.

measures.name: Lost Energy Value USD
measures.expression: [Lost Energy MWh] * [Contract Price USD per MWh]
measures.description: Lost energy at the contract price.

measures.name: Budget P50 MWh
measures.description: Budget energy, whole months.

measures.name: Budget P90 MWh
measures.description: The cautious case, whole months.

measures.name: Budget Revenue USD
measures.description: P50 energy at the contract price.

measures.name: Budget Repair Cost USD
measures.description: Budget for corrective maintenance.

measures.name: Energy vs Budget
measures.description: Energy as a share of the P50 budget. Meaningful for whole months.

measures.name: Captured Price USD per MWh
measures.description: The real-time market price weighted by when the site produced.

measures.name: Mean Real-Time Price USD per MWh
measures.description: Plain average of the hourly real-time price.

measures.name: Forecast Error
measures.description: Mean absolute difference between the day-ahead forecast and possible power, as a share of the site's capacity.

measures.name: Wind Index
measures.description: Mean wind speed at the met mast relative to the long-term mean of the same months. Meaningful for whole months.
